title: Refining and Reusing Annotation Guidelines for LLM Annotation
original_location: Table 1, block NCBI (791), row GPT-5, column group S (simple prompting): P 0.45, R 0.48, F1 0.46, TP 378
approximation: The runner sends the prompt as a chat completion without response_format={'type':'json_object'} (the runner drops response_format for reasoning models); the paper's provider sets it together with the JSON-mode system message, which is kept. Span realignment is a simplified version of the repo's align_annotations (exact offsets first, otherwise the nearest occurrence of the returned span text). Strict-match scoring is re-implemented (exact begin/end/label, one-to-one) instead of calling the authors' PubAnnotation evaluator with soft_match 0.
